REBELLIA-BLOOD_SWORD_ART_POWER.title: 鲜血剑艺

REBELLIA-CRIMSON_VEIL_POWER.title: 猩红面纱

回合结束时失去[blue]1[/blue]层猩红面纱并获得[blue]1[/blue]鲜血剑艺。
